purpose: Справочный атлас возможностей; не обязательный план разработки
application_context_policy: No LifeGame feature list in search, analysis or general selection; separate mapping after release

research_bounds.raw_findings_orientation: 1000–2000 planning/organization plus about 1000 game-related; may grow beyond 10000; no padding
research_bounds.stop_rule: coverage and two comparable targeted waves with less than 10 percent new canonical elements; remaining gaps documented

known_limits: No automatic API calls to external models; user transfers packets manually or delegates specific search tasks explicitly
VM shell has no direct internet curl/wget, but orchestrator has google:search and google:browse tools
Calibration target is 40-60 real findings across 4 tasks, so target=200 will naturally report target_reached=false
